— 200
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully deleted the access group you specified.
— 403 Returned if you do not have sufficient permissions to delete an access group.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management could not find the access group you specified.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
